args.text:
Batch: 8 runs (r01–r08). All 8 were accepted. 0 flagged, 8 cleared.
- Checks: rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections passed on every run. None of the runs used the width-free ratio.
- Summaries: The large |z| values come from a near-zero batch MAD, not from real outliers. r07's REGR peak is 0.05 %/h below the median (about 0.1 %, z −3.4). r04 and r08 peak 0.03 %/h higher and have a growth zone 15 µm shorter. The flank-difference position in r01, r05 and r06 is 11 µm closer to the tip. Every root has its REGR peak at 421 µm and a growth zone of 674–695 µm.
- Remedies: r04 and r08 each kept one remedy. With it, every check passed and the profiles match the batch, which is the normal path. No run was rolled back.
- No runs were flagged, so there is no shared pattern to report.
